llm_response.reason: The website demonstrates multiple scam indicators: (1) Promises of ultra-high ROI (up to 80%) and instant withdrawals, which are generally impossible in legitimate trading; (2) Recent domain registration in Panama, a common location for scam shell companies, contradicting their claim of '10+ years experience'; (3) No verifiable company contact or regulatory information; (4) Accepts deposits only via crypto wallets, an unusual and high-risk payment method for investments; (5) Uses urgency tactics like 'Start Now,' referral programs, and guaranteed returns; (6) Fake testimonials and ambiguous privacy. All evidence points to a classic Investment Scam.
